title: Fed&\#x27;s Daly Says Further Rate Hikes Likely as Inflation Persists
summary: San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly said Friday she expects further interest-rate increases will likely be needed, citing persistent inflation; September consumer prices rose 3.7% from a year earlier, above the 3.1% annual rise in average hourly earnings in October.

references.title: Fed rate decision September 2026 : Rates rise to 3.75%-4%
